{{Quote|They've found us!|Kal Jorek|<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref>}}
'''Kal Jorek''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]], who worked as a weapons [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] for the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]].

==Biography==
Working alongside his right hand man, the [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] [[Frizz (Defel)|Frizz]], Jorek worked importing illegal weapons to peaceful [[Star system/Legends|systems]]. They would then inflict chaos and fear onto the local populations, to create demand for their weapons. They once traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], where they sold weapons from a warehouse on the outskirts of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital city]]. While they were there, the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Naboo Security officer]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Trayl Caltos]] hired some [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to stake out the warehouse and capture Jorek and Frizz.
